note: Triennial election of Irvinestown Rural District Council, polled Thursday 4 June 1964 (no poll was needed). The Impartial Reporter of 21 May 1964, p. 7, reports the close of nominations: 'There will be no contests for Irvinestown Rural Council - 19 nominations were handed in, one for each division', with three changes (Belleek, Churchhill, Lisnarick) and the other sixteen nominations, all named by division. Returned unopposed.
